definitions.gloss: cannibalism among animals; eating one's own kind
definitions.explanation: The behavior of animals eating members of their own species. A natural phenomenon observed in many animal species.

definitions.gloss: infighting; undermining allies; competing destructively within the same group
definitions.explanation: Used figuratively for situations where members of the same group, party, or industry harm each other through competition, rather than cooperating against external rivals.

examples.japanese: ハムスターは{共食|ともぐ}いをすることがある。
ストレスが{原因|げんいん}で{魚|さかな}の{共食|ともぐ}いが{起|お}きることがある。
examples.english: Stress can cause fish to eat each other.

examples.japanese: {過度|かど}な{価格競争|かかくきょうそう}は{業界内|ぎょうかいない}の{共食|ともぐ}いにつながる。
examples.english: Excessive price competition leads to destructive infighting within the industry.

examples.japanese: {自社|じしゃ}ブランドの{新商品|しんしょうひん}が{既存|きそん}{商品|しょうひん}と{共食|ともぐ}いしている。
examples.english: The company's new product is cannibalizing its existing products.

examples.japanese: {与党内|よとうない}の{共食|ともぐ}いが{続|つづ}いている。
examples.english: Infighting within the ruling party continues.

examples.japanese: {同|おな}じ{地域|ちいき}に{店舗|てんぽ}を{出|だ}しすぎると{共食|ともぐ}いになる。
examples.english: Opening too many stores in the same area leads to cannibalization.

notes: A compound of {共|とも} (together/mutual) + {食|く}い (eating, from {食|く}う). In business, {共食|ともぐ}い corresponds to the English marketing term 'cannibalization,' where a company's own new product takes sales from its existing products. Can function as a する verb: {共食|ともぐ}いする.
